run_translation_generation: run the fairseq generate CLI to translate pre-processed data with a trained model
run_bleu_scoring: run the fairseq generate CLI to compute BLEU scores on generated translations
run_beam_search_generation: run the fairseq generate CLI with beam search to produce top-N hypotheses
run_alignment_generation: run the fairseq generate CLI with --print-alignment to output source-target word alignments
run_prefix_constrained_generation: run the fairseq generate CLI with --prefix-size to constrain generation with prefix tokens
